string-array.name: xtra5_shortcuts
string-array.item: Items marked [TV] need the setting Enable TV mode shortcuts. They work with a TV remote, keyboard or game controller.
# Anywhere in the app
- Back on a section\'s main page (Following, Games...): goes to Following > Live and refreshes it. Back on Live exits the app.
- [TV] Hold OK with no video, or with the video minimized: refreshes every section of the screen.
# Bottom bar
- Following, pressed again on Following\'s main page: switches to Live, refreshes it and scrolls to the top (already on Live: refreshes and scrolls to the top).
# Following > Live and stream lists
- Tap the Live tab: refreshes the Live list and scrolls to the top.
- Long-press a stream card: opens the stream in audio-only, just this once (your quality setting isn\'t changed).

- Long-press a streamer\'s profile picture: adds or removes them as a favourite (gold ring and star) and lists them first in Live. Shared with Following > Channels: favouriting here shows the ring and star there too, and vice versa.
# Following > Channels

- Long-press a profile picture: adds or removes the channel as a favourite. Shared with Following > Live: favouriting here shows the ring and star there and moves them to the top of Live, and vice versa.
- Long-press anywhere else on a channel: opens their channel page on its Chat tab, live or offline.
- [TV] Hold OK on a channel: opens their chat (instead of refreshing).
Setting: Favourites first
# [TV] Video player (full screen, controls hidden)
- Left / Right: skip back / forward and show the seek bar (VODs, clips, downloads). While it shows, Left / Right keep skipping and Back hides the controls.
Setting: Seek step (seconds)
- Up: shows the controls and takes hold of the seek bar (live streams: just shows the controls).
-- Left / Right: moves the marker; hold to keep moving.
Setting: Seek bar jump (% of video length)
-- OK: jumps to the marker.
-- Up: lets go (jumping there if the marker moved). From there, Up / Down / Left / Right move around the controls as usual.
-- Back: cancels the move (also cancels by itself after 6 seconds). If the marker hasn\'t moved, hides the controls.
-- After jumping, while the controls are still showing: Left / Right skip by the seek step, Back hides the controls.
Setting: Seek step (seconds)
- Down: opens Chapters, if the VOD has any. On a live stream: shows or hides the chat.
Setting: Chapter columns (landscape), Chapter columns (portrait)
- Hold OK on a live stream: reloads the stream (like Restart player).
- Hold Back: closes the video.
# Video player (touch)

- ! button (top right): the channel\'s chat-bot commands (Nightbot, StreamElements, Fossabot) and their replies, in a table you can scroll and search, with emotes shown as in chat. Tap a command: puts it in your message box (or copies it if chat isn\'t open). Long-press: copies the reply. Also in each Dual Stream video\'s controls.
- Touch and hold the video (a short buzz), then slide left / right: changes the volume (half the video\'s width is 0 to 100%), with a volume bar while you slide. Same volume as the Volume button.

- VODs: touch and hold the bottom strip of the video (a short buzz), then drag left / right: rewinds / fast-forwards: the first half of the drag is small steps (2s to 1m), then bigger ones up to hours, and the start / end in the last ~200 pixels of the screen. The video keeps playing; a two-sided pill shows the jump and the gold marker waits on the seek bar. Let go to jump; drag back to the start to cancel.
# Minimized video
- Tap a paused mini player: resumes it.
- [TV] Back: closes the video.
- [TV] Hold Back: closes the video.
# Dual Stream
- Tap the big + on the Dual Stream tab: type two channels (Stream 1 and Stream 2), each with its own quality and volume.
- Watch: both videos in one screen: side by side, or stacked in portrait. Chats are hidden when it opens.
- Tap a recent pair: opens the popup with it filled in. Long-press it: removes it.

- Tap a video (or OK on it): shows its controls: pause / play in the middle, then mute, volume, quality, chat, message box, swap, replace, reload, watch only this and fullscreen. They hide after 4 seconds.
-- Chat button: shows or hides both chats (under the videos; in portrait, side by side under both videos). Chat doesn\'t work properly in Dual Stream.
-- Message box button (while chats show): shows or hides that stream\'s chat input. Hidden by default.
-- Pause / play (big button in the middle): pauses that stream only. Playing again jumps to live.
-- Touch and hold a video, then slide left / right: changes that video\'s volume (half the video\'s width is 0 to 100%), with a volume bar while you slide.
-- Swap button: the two streams change places.
-- Swipe down on a video (or the Replace button, TV icon): puts another channel in that stream\'s place.
-- Swipe up on a video (or the Watch only this button): closes the other stream and plays this one on its own in the normal player.
-- Back: leaves fullscreen first, otherwise closes Dual Stream.
-- Remote, keyboard or controller (no setting needed): Left / Right / Up / Down move between the two videos and their controls. The selected video has a gold outline.
# Chat
- Messages with bits (cheers) get their own background color, from a minimum number of bits. Setting: Settings > Chat > Special messages > Cheers (bits).
- Tap an emote: shows the emote\'s details.
- Long-press an emote: puts it in your message (not sent; the chat input appears if it was hidden).
- Long-press a message or name: adds the chatter to your default highlight group, or takes them out.
Setting: Set as default group
# Color picker
- Long-press a saved color: removes it.
